fields.title: 8. Three data points to check yourself before the next issue
fields.md:
1. **T7 ⓕ deadline 11/30**: Check whether SpaceX has confirmed record preservation and submitted a reply, via the Foreign Relations Committee minority press release. Also check at the same place whether the replies to ⓘ·ⓓ2·ⓖ have been published (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T7].paths`).
2. **Himes letter full text**: Check whether the House Intelligence Committee minority has posted the full text, and what 'government-owned system' refers to (name and amount) (source: `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).
3. **Existing checkpoints**: Ariane 64 LE-04 (11/23, T4) · DA 26-1160 reconsideration deadline (11/27, T8) · monthly 12/01 · T2 12/8 lock-up · T12 12/9 vote (source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
